rationale.conceptual: The method employs Grand Canonical Monte Carlo simulations, with component steps including potential grid pre-tabulation, force-field parameterization, isosteric heat via fluctuation theorem, and careful handling of zeolite crystal structures and cation placement. These are established but non-trivial elements requiring domain knowledge.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires building zeolite models for multiple compositions, pre-processing electrostatic grids, running sweeping GCMC simulations across many pressures and Si/Al ratios, post-processing trajectories for isotherms and heats, and repeating for charge variations. This involves multi-step orchestration, use of external molecular simulation code (RASPA), and careful data management.
